这两天看到 @termix_ai 接入 Binance Agent ID 的消息，我觉得这个方向挺有想象力

很多人关注的是 AI Agent 能不能自动交易、自动执行任务，但我觉得还有一个更基础的问题：两个互不认识的 AI Agent，凭什么相信对方？

假设未来一个 Agent 负责研究市场，另一个负责风险分析，第三个负责执行策略

它们之间要合作，就不能只靠简单的 API 调用

还需要知道对方是谁、有什么能力、过去完成过哪些任务，以及出了问题该由谁负责

TermiX 最近展示了通过 Binance Agent ID 进行 Agent 间消息通信的能力，再结合 http://Agent.family 的任务市场、链上托管和信誉机制，我认为它正在尝试搭建一套 AI Agent 的商业协作网络

在我看来，Agent ID 解决的是身份和连接问题，而 TermiX 更想解决连接之后如何产生交易的问题

当然，能够互相发送消息，不代表已经建立了成熟的信任关系

真正值得关注的，是未来 Agent 能不能通过历史交付记录积累信誉，并凭借信誉获得更多订单

如果这条路能走通，AI Agent 可能不只是一个工具，而会逐渐拥有自己的商业履历

这才是我觉得 Termix 值得深入研究的地方

@KaitoAI  @termix_ai

posts.text:
New Meta paper shows that a personal AI agent can improve an app's recommendations with your history from other apps, if it learns when to defer.

Each app ranks items using only what you did there, plus patterns from other users. A personal agent sees activity across apps, but it can also break a good ranking by dropping the right item.

They built PAMO, a training method that hides the cross-app history to see which of the agent's answers depend on it. Answers that lean on that history get more credit, but only if ranking accuracy does not drop.

On real Steam users with Nintendo and Xbox history, a 4B PAMO agent reached 47.9% top-10 hit rate, versus 40.8% for the platform. It also beat standard RL training on all 5 test sets.

Personal agents that edit other apps' results should defer by default and override only when the user's history gives specific evidence.

– arxiv. org/abs/2610.07588

Title: "Personal-Agent Mediated Recommendation with Cross-Platform User History"

note_tweet.text:
New Meta paper shows that a personal AI agent can improve an app's recommendations with your history from other apps, if it learns when to defer.

Each app ranks items using only what you did there, plus patterns from other users. A personal agent sees activity across apps, but it can also break a good ranking by dropping the right item.

They built PAMO, a training method that hides the cross-app history to see which of the agent's answers depend on it. Answers that lean on that history get more credit, but only if ranking accuracy does not drop.

On real Steam users with Nintendo and Xbox history, a 4B PAMO agent reached 47.9% top-10 hit rate, versus 40.8% for the platform. It also beat standard RL training on all 5 test sets.

Personal agents that edit other apps' results should defer by default and override only when the user's history gives specific evidence.

– arxiv. org/abs/2610.07588

Title: "Personal-Agent Mediated Recommendation with Cross-Platform User History"

posts.text:
一个产品再有亮点，也难免有需要改进的地方。对于 @primus_labs 来说，如果想让更多普通用户和开发者真正用起来，现阶段还有哪些细节值得打磨，哪些地方可以做得更好？

我觉得它目前的方向是比较明确的。zkTLS 解决 Web2 数据如何被验证的问题，隐私计算则让这些数据在使用过程中尽可能减少不必要的暴露。这件事本身有实际需求，不只是一个听起来很新鲜的技术概念。

不过，技术有价值，不代表用户就一定愿意使用。

比如现在涉及部分验证任务时，用户需要了解数据来源、授权流程以及具体的验证步骤。对于熟悉 Web3 的人来说可能不算什么，但如果面向更广泛的普通用户，操作流程还是越简单越好。用户不需要知道 zkTLS 背后的每个技术细节，只需要清楚自己授权了什么、验证了什么，以及自己的数据有没有被妥善保护。

还有一个我比较关注的地方，就是数据源和应用场景。

zkTLS 最终能发挥多大价值，很大程度上取决于它能连接多少真实的数据源。现在大家提到的往往是交易记录、社交数据和身份验证，但未来如果能覆盖更多生活和商业场景，比如消费记录、会员权益、教育经历，甚至 AI 使用记录，开发者能够做的事情就会多很多。

当然，光有数据还不够。开发者能不能方便地接入，能不能用较低的成本把验证能力整合到自己的产品里，也会直接影响生态发展。SDK、文档、开发案例和调试工具这些看起来不太起眼的东西，其实都很重要。毕竟，一个技术再好，如果集成起来太麻烦，开发者也未必愿意花时间。

我个人最期待的，还是看到@primus_labs 从技术展示走向更多真实应用。

例如 DeFi 能不能利用经过验证的链下数据改善信用服务？AI Agent 能不能在不获取用户全部隐私的情况下完成身份和权限验证？这些问题如果能逐步得到实际应用的回答，Primus 的价值就不再只是停留在技术介绍里。

所以我并不是觉得 Primus 现在有什么明显的短板，而是认为它已经走到了一个需要继续打磨产品和生态的阶段。

技术方向决定了想象空间，用户体验决定了有多少人愿意留下，真实应用才决定这套基础设施最终能走多远。

接下来比起看到更多宏大的叙事，我更希望看到的是：越来越多开发者愿意接入，越来越多用户真正用上它。

#PrimusLabs #KaitoAI

Learn to build evals, folks!

You are not RSI-pilled enough if you don't know how to properly measure the thing you want to improve.

It doesn't matter if it's a model, complex codebase, or a business function. This is extremely hard in the real world.

You ever wonder why most of what AI is great at today is around verifiable problems? 

The open-ended world requires a completely different approach to improving and measuring models.

We need to go back to hardcore science and evals. Enough of this short-term benchmaxxing.

This space offers so much opportunity. We are doing research and building evals in this space @dair_ai. I am currently chatting with folks building in this space too. Feel free to reach out for potential collab opportunities or just share perspectives.

posts.text_zh:
去学怎么做评测吧！

如果你还不会正确度量想改进的东西，说明你还不够「RSI-pilled」。

不管是模型、复杂代码库还是业务功能，在真实世界里这都极难。

有没有想过，为什么今天 AI 最擅长的，大多是可验证问题？

开放世界需要完全不同的改进与度量方法。

我们得回到硬核科学与评测，够了那些短期刷榜。

这里机会很大。我们在 @dair_ai 做研究和构建评测，也在与相关建设者交流——欢迎联系合作或交换看法。

I'm torn on raising for slopcannon. I love building it the OG way with my own money and running the whole show with my gut. 

100% growth in the 2nd month. Zero saas membership bullshit like all the VC want bc the recurring number looks good. All real sales from real customers who pay per use, not people who forgot to cancel their subscription while I sell "unlimited usage plans" that are just long horrible queues while you get your clips back one by one (looking at you higgsfield and runway.)

You can build for the people or for the investors. I'm building for the people.

Will I be able to bootstrap this to 100k in November to keep 100% growth? Imagine how funny it would be. 

I'll use this money to buy our first ads and run it up as much as I can out of my own pocket because that's where the prestige is. That's where the fun is. I'm knee deep in a hot pile of shit loving every moment of it, rawdogging it, bringing the whole gang up, willing it into existence.

that's a lot cooler than raising a million dollars for some silly glasses to tread water and die slow only to find there's no pmf. 

how do you even manufacture and distribute glasses with a million dollars? that's like one dude and his token budget. 

what can the numbers possibly look like. what is the tam? mumblers muttering in meetings? you think people are gonna be hiring mumblers when superintelligence is around the corner? 

if i hired a fucking mumbler and they put these fucking things oh boy it's not gonna be pretty.

anyway $47k sloptober let's fucking GOOOOOO
